subject: general
question: Who among the following has been awarded with Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021 for "Para Shooting"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avani Lekhara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Avani Lekhara

 
 
• Avani Lekhara, an Indian Paralympian and rifle shooter, was born on November 8, 2001.
 
• At the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics, she earned a Gold Medal in the 10m air rifle standing event and a Bronze Medal in the 50m rifle three positions event.
 
• In 2022, Avani Lekhara receives the Padma Shri award from former President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• She is the first Indian woman to win two medals in the same Paralympics and the country's first gold medalist.
 
• At the Sportstar Aces Awards in Mumbai, Abhinav Bindra presents para-shooter Avani Lekhara with the Sportswoman of the Year (Parasports) award.
 
• She won Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021 in Para Shooting discipline.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 

 
 
• The highest athletic honour in India in Sports and Games is the Khel Ratna Award, also known as the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award and formerly the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award.
 
• The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports distributes it every year.
 
• Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient for this award, recognized for his efforts in the academic year 1991–1992.
